_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-standalone xonotic/egg-xonotic.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail changes the install script (the release zip over HTTPS with mirrors, checked against xonotic.org's published SHA-512 list and, for 0.8.6, against the sum recorded in the script; no switch to the unchecked rsync autobuild; only the Linux dedicated binary, its key and data/ unpacked; a reinstall keeps data/server.cfg and added files but removes an older release's packages; failures exit non-zero), runs it on octail-yolks' Debian image (upstream: a SteamCMD image), writes a minimal data/server.cfg once (upstream's copy in .xonotic/data was never edited, so name and slots stayed the defaults) and edits it with the file parser before every start (port, name, slots, public listing, message of the day, game type, rcon password), keeps the port also on the command line for the first bind, and adds the xonotic tag, the say broadcast, install sandbox defaults and resource hints.
name: Xonotic
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Xonotic is a free, fast-paced open-source arena shooter (deathmatch, CTF, clan arena and more), the successor of Nexuiz.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Xonotic installation script (Octail): the official release zip from dl.xonotic.org (a mirror when it's down),
# checked against the SHA-512 list xonotic.org publishes (and, for 0.8.6, against the sum recorded here), with only
# what the dedicated server needs unpacked: the Linux 64-bit dedicated binary, its key and data/. Failures exit
# non-zero.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

## Xonotic 0.8.6's sum from https://dl.xonotic.org/xonotic-0.8.6.sha512, so a changed list can't pass for it
SHA512_086=cb39879e96f19abb2877588c2d50c5d3e64dd68153bec3dd1bebedf4d765e506afa419c28381d7005aed664cb1a042571c132b5b319e4308cab67745d996c2a6

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip ca-certificates > /dev/null

if [ "$(uname -m)" != x86_64 ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: Xonotic ships its Linux dedicated server for x86_64 only (this node is $(uname -m))."
    exit 1
fi

VERSION="${XONOTIC_VERSION:-0.8.6}"
ZIP="xonotic-${VERSION}.zip"
if ! SUMS=$(curl -fsSL "https://dl.xonotic.org/xonotic-${VERSION}.sha512"); then
    echo "Installation failed: xonotic.org lists no SHA-512 sums for Xonotic ${VERSION} (check the version)."
    exit 1
fi
SUM=$(echo "$SUMS" | awk -v f="$ZIP" '$2 == f { print $1; exit }')
if [ -z "$SUM" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: ${ZIP} isn't in xonotic.org's SHA-512 list."
    exit 1
fi
if [ "$VERSION" = 0.8.6 ] && [ "$SUM" != "$SHA512_086" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: xonotic.org's SHA-512 for ${ZIP} isn't the one recorded in this egg."
    exit 1
fi

cd /mnt/server
## about 1.2 GB: downloaded into the server folder (the installer's /tmp may be small), removed afterwards
DL=/mnt/server/.xonotic-download.zip
OK=
for MIRROR in https://dl.xonotic.org https://xonotic.antzucaro.com https://download.evil-ant-colony.org/xonotic; do
    echo "Downloading ${MIRROR}/${ZIP}"
    if curl -fSL --retry 2 -o "$DL" "${MIRROR}/${ZIP}" && echo "$SUM  $DL" | sha512sum -c --quiet -; then
        OK=1
        break
    fi
    echo "That download failed or doesn't match its checksum; trying the next mirror."
done
if [ -z "$OK" ]; then
    rm -f "$DL"
    echo "Installation failed: no mirror gave a download matching xonotic.org's SHA-512."
    exit 1
fi

## the game's own files only: server.cfg, maps and anything else you added to data/ stay on a reinstall
rm -rf /mnt/server/.xonotic-unpack
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.xonotic-unpack data
unzip -q -o "$DL" 'Xonotic/xonotic-linux64-dedicated' 'Xonotic/key_0.d0pk' 'Xonotic/data/*' 'Xonotic/server/*' \
    -d /mnt/server/.xonotic-unpack
rm -f "$DL"
U=/mnt/server/.xonotic-unpack/Xonotic
if [ ! -f "$U/xonotic-linux64-dedicated" ] || ! ls "$U"/data/xonotic-*-data.pk3 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    rm -rf /mnt/server/.xonotic-unpack
    echo "Installation failed: the dedicated server or its data is missing from ${ZIP}."
    exit 1
fi
## an older release's packages would load next to the new ones
rm -f data/xonotic-*.pk3 data/font-*.pk3
mv -f "$U"/data/* data/
mv -f "$U/xonotic-linux64-dedicated" "$U/key_0.d0pk" .
chmod +x xonotic-linux64-dedicated
rm -rf server
mv "$U/server" server
rm -rf /mnt/server/.xonotic-unpack

## a minimal data/server.cfg, only when there is none; Octail sets the lines below before every start, and
## server/server.cfg is the release's example with every common setting explained
if [ ! -f data/server.cfg ]; then
    cat > data/server.cfg <<'EOF'
// Xonotic server settings. Octail sets the lines below before every start (Startup tab); add your own settings
// under them. Examples with explanations: server/server.cfg. All settings: 'cvarlist' in the console.
port 26000
hostname "Xonotic Server"
maxplayers 16
sv_public 1
sv_motd ""
gametype dm
rcon_password ""
EOF
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: Xonotic ${VERSION}."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Xonotic Version
variables.description: The release to install, such as 0.8.6 (xonotic.org must list its SHA-512). Players need the same release. Reinstall to switch.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server list (up to 64 characters, no double quotes or backslashes; $g_xonoticversion shows the version).

variables.name: Public Server List
variables.description: 1 lists the server in the in-game server browser; 0 keeps it off the list (players join by address).

variables.name: Message of the Day
variables.description: Optional: shown when players connect, a good place for contact details (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Game Type
variables.description: The game mode from the next map on: dm, tdm, ctf, ca (clan arena), ft (freeze tag), kh, as, dom, lms, ka, inv, ons, rc, cts, nb or duel.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Optional: the remote console password for the in-game rcon command (8-64 characters, no spaces, quotes or backslashes). Empty = rcon off.
